notes.title: An Update Plan on Blackthorn Arena and a Milestone for Our Studio
notes.content:
Dear Blackthorn Arena community,
First and foremost, thank you for your continued passion and patience. We know it’s been a while since our last update, and we want to speak to that directly.

While our development efforts have recently been focused on Age of Reforging: The Freelands, we want to reassure you that Blackthorn Arena: Reforged is not forgotten. We’re actively working on new content, including [b]new enemies, weapons, and fresh arena mechanics[/b], and we’ll have more to share with you soon.

We understand that the lack of communication may have been frustrating, and we sincerely apologize for that. Going forward, we’ll strive to be more transparent about what we’re working on and what you can expect.

[h1]Now, a Major Milestone for Our Studio[/h1]
Today, we're proud to share that Age of Reforging: The Freelands, a sister project built with the same grit and spirit as Blackthorn Arena, has officially launched into version 1.0.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1161830/_/

This marks the end of a long journey through Early Access. While it’s not perfect, it’s a project we’ve poured our hearts into. For those curious or interested in our studio’s broader work, here’s a quick look at what’s included in the 1.0 release:

[list]
[*][b] A massive, handcrafted open world[/b] with over 30 regions and multiple biomes

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172175/8c77db5cecab1e46f71da952df83cd97a7e2cf0a.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Overhauled core systems[/b], from stat progression to randomized gear

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172175/bf3dc55b14242672ad9f0c9c5c46a3b9db9ec81d.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Tons of content[/b], including 2,500+ items, 200+ enemies, 150+ quests, and 700+ NPCs

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172175/b0374f27b4b82f8ccc5e49cac9c5f6628ce75cbd.gif[/img]

[*] [b]A rich narrative[/b], featuring over 800,000 Chinese characters of story content

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172175/13ec5845e530f671248f27df6a75461a9171a339.gif[/img]

[/list]

We’re continuing to expand The Freelands. Just as importantly, we’re also returning our focus to Blackthorn Arena and the updates still to come.

[h1]A Bundle for Our Supporters[/h1]
We’ve created the Reforgers Bundle on Steam, which includes both Blackthorn Arena and Age of Reforging at a discounted price. It’s a way to thank those who want to explore both worlds we’ve built.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48928/Reforgers_Bundle/

Thank you again for sticking with us. Your feedback, your passion, and your expectations mean everything to us. We’re listening, and we’re building.
With respect,
[b] The PersonaeGame Studio Team[/b]

notes.title: 2025 New Year’s Greeting and Future Update Plan | Blackthorn Arena: Reforged
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Arena Masters,[/h3]

As the new year approaches, our entire development team would like to extend our sincerest wishes to every player: Happy New Year and may all your wishes come true! Thank you for your support and attention to Blackthorn Arena: Reforged over the past year. Whether through purchasing the game, participating in the experience, or providing valuable feedback, every bit of support from you has given us tremendous motivation.

Looking back at 2024, it has been a fulfilling yet challenging year. Since the game's release, we have encountered various obstacles and breakthroughs, and we’ve seen countless players fighting valiantly in the arena. These experiences have brought both moments of joy and the pressure to improve. We have listened carefully to every piece of player feedback, striving to make the game better. Although the game still has some imperfections, occasional stubborn bugs, and there is much room for optimization, please trust that we are committed to continuous improvement to provide a better experience for everyone.

In the new year, we have developed a detailed update plan for Blackthorn Arena: Reforged, and we’d like to share some of the upcoming content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172175/6f562a5336ce2c83ad120c1d0b14d5d1383000b0.jpg[/img]

[h3]1. Wuxia DLC (Expected Mid-February 2025)[/h3]

We will be releasing the Wuxia DLC in February, which will bring a whole new Chinese-themed content to the game. Players will experience a completely different combat style with the unique charm of classical martial arts.

DLC Highlights include:

[list]
[*]     Chinese-style Arenas: Newly designed battlefields with a strong Eastern Wuxia atmosphere.
[*]     New Armor and Attire: Brand new Wuxia-themed gear, allowing your gladiator to have a unique look.
[*]     New Weapons and Legendary Weapons: Classic weapons like swords, sabers, and spears, along with some legendary weapons that bring more strategic depth to combat.
[*]     Legendary Characters and Martial Arts Schools: New legendary characters and exclusive martial arts schools, offering varied combat styles and fresh gameplay experiences.
[/list]

[h3]2. Mid-Year Regular Updates[/h3]

In the first half of 2025, we will continue to roll out regular updates to keep the game feeling fresh and continually optimize the player experience.

Update Content includes:

[list]
[*]     New DLC Outfits and Legendary Weapons: Expanding character customization and weapon options.
[*]     Bug Fixes and Balance Changes: Further optimization of game performance and combat balance based on player feedback.
[*]     Free Regular Community Updates: To give back to the community, we will continue to release free content updates, adding new challenges and features.

[*] When lightly loaded, the character will receive a certain amount of bonus to dodge, attack speed, movement speed, and stamina saving.
[*]  When heavily loaded, the character will receive a certain amount of penalty to dodge, attack speed, movement speed, and stamina saving.
[*] When medium loaded, there will be no bonus or penalty.
[/list]

-Characters can now dodge charging skills.
- The initial random attributes of the characters in the Role library are now consistent with the initial random attribute range of the market characters.

[b]Weapons and armor:[/b]
- Bows and crossbows now reload immediately after firing
- Bows, crossbows and quivers have had their damage increased by 1.5
- Polearms have had their damage reduced by 1
- Adjusted the stamina cost of some two-handed and polearm weapons, and increased them overall
- Slightly increased the armor resistance of the Freeman
- Slightly increased the attributes and levels of some of the weaker champions


[b]Animations:[/b]
- Power strike :  The animation speed  has been reduced by 20
- Lunge : The animation speed has been increased by 30
- Bow and Crossbow: The animation speed of the attack and reload has been increased by 20

[b]Skills:[/b]
- Injuring Palm:   Remove the damage of time effect. Its damage type changed from sustained to soul damage.
- Martial arts master: Resistance penetration has been reduced from a maximum of 75% to 50%, but it will increase the basic damage of the maximum 6% physical strength vaule.
- Quick Heal: The life recovery speed has been reduced from 4/6/8 to 2/3/4
- Power Strike: The cooldown has been increased from 12 seconds to 15 seconds, and the Stamina consumption has been increased from 1.5 times the weapon value to 2 times

[h2][b]Improvements:[/b][/h2]
[b]Features:[/b]
[b]* When creating a custom character in role library, players can now select initial traits under certain rules. [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172175/490b385295dcf3d195099e7d8e8ec3155385dde0.png[/img]
- When selling and buying gladiators, you can now also view the gladiator's equipment.
- When viewing a character, you can now view his equipment.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172175/9a8aca7bce3e925f5aaf640ddacb36eb9ec66300.png[/img]
- The automatic save before reading the dispatch task is now not repeated when the task is executed again.

[b]UI:[/b]
- The UI for selecting the initial gladiator at the start of the game has been improved.
- When viewing a character in the purchase interface, hovering the mouse over the genre will display an introduction to the genre's characteristics.
- Players will now be given more obvious prompts when they obtain items.
- Buffs now display the duration on the icon.
- The UI of the match and mission settlement screen has been optimized. Excess loot now no longer extends beyond the UI frame, but is displayed using a slider.

[b]Scenarios:[/b]
[b]* In the sewer scene of some missions, the character can now fall into the water and climb back up the ladder.[/b]
- Improved lighting effects in multiple scenes
